chapter: Early influences, Oliver date and trombone peers
title: Bunk Johnson
summary: He played a gig and a New Jersey recording with Bunk Johnson, who was old and drunk; they barely talked.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Buddy Bolden and Buddy Petit: the trumpet legends

blocks.x: Well, he's a trumpet player. I played a couple of engagements with him. They sent for him to come to New York and play one gig at the Army Club there on 52nd Street. And I played one, no, we did a recording down in New Jersey; and he's playing behind a crate too loud, pushing him further too loud; ... drunk, back ... He was old. He was way up in his 70s when he passed.
But, you didn't know him earlier?
No, no, no. I don't think I've spoken to him over, I haven't had over two conversations with him in my life.
